annotations.title: NFL Player Prop Edge (model vs Kalshi)

description: Use for "best NFL props today" and "receiving yards prop value". Our projection vs the Kalshi "X or more" prop line: the contract, the YES/NO call, our odds and Kalshi's price for that side, the projection and the edge, with WATCH rows labelled. Live in season. Pro — sign in with PredictionMarketsPicks, or a Pro API key.

limit.description: Max rows (default 10). Values above 25 are clamped to 25.

minEdge.description: Min absolute edge in pp (default 5). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("3", "3pp", "3%").

propType.description: Optional filter by prop type: pass_yds, pass_tds, rush_yds, rec_yds, receptions, anytime_td.
